inphared.scientific_interpretation: Mash selects candidate references only. PhageMine reports its own bidirectional BLASTN length-normalized similarity and does not claim VIRIDIC equivalence or make an ICTV assignment. Taxonomic boundary interpretation is withheld for partial or poorly aligned queries.
